resumeTailoringRules: Never invent employers, dates, metrics, or technologies not already present in resume/master-resume.tex.
Tailoring means: reordering the Skills list so JD-relevant items lead, reweighting which bullets appear first/are elaborated, and adjusting the Summary's wording to mirror the JD's language.
Keep every factual claim (dates, employers, quantified metrics like '10+ TB/day', '30+ accounts', '99.95% uptime') exactly as in the base resume.
Output must be a complete, valid, compilable standalone .tex document using the same preamble/environments as the base resume.
